# Orbit

> Mission control for autonomous coding agents. A terminal cockpit (TUI) that
> supervises, steers, and verifies multi-agent software development: every
> task runs in its own throwaway Git worktree, with human-in-the-loop
> verification gates, custom multi-phase pipelines, and a full append-only
> audit trail of everything an agent did.

Orbit drives coding-agent CLIs (Claude Code today; Codex and OpenCode next,
Gemini after that) and streams their output back in real time, so you can
run several tasks in parallel — even in the same repo — without ever
touching your own working tree.

Built by Elio Rincón ([e1i0.com](https://e1i0.com)).

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/e1i0r/orbit#readme): install, quickstart, keybindings, and the full feature list
- [Install script](https://getorbit.sh/install.sh): `curl -fsSL https://getorbit.sh/install.sh | bash`
- [Contributing guide](https://github.com/e1i0r/orbit/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): how to build the project and send a pull request
- [License](https://github.com/e1i0r/orbit/blob/main/LICENSE): Apache License 2.0
